meta.name: confirm-action
meta.description: Ask the user to confirm before taking a significant action. Use before containment, remediation, or other impactful operations to ensure analyst approval. Presents options and waits for response.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在关键操作前请求用户确认，防止误操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在执行高危操作前获得人工批准
copy.tagline_en: Ask for user confirmation before critical actions to prevent mistakes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need human approval before executing high-impact operations

howto.what: 在采取重要操作（如隔离端点、禁用账户、封禁IP等）前，Claude会先向你提问确认，并提供预设选项，等待你的回复后再继续。
howto.when: 当Claude要执行封锁、隔离、删除等有影响的操作时触发。对于只读操作（如添加注释、查询）则跳过确认。

say.text: 禁用用户 jsmith 的账户
say.note: Claude会提供禁用、重置密码等选项。

howto.what_en: Before taking significant actions (e.g., isolating endpoints, disabling accounts, blocking IPs), Claude asks you for confirmation with predefined options and waits for your response before proceeding.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude is about to perform impactful operations like containment, remediation, or deletion. Read-only actions (e.g., adding comments, running queries) skip confirmation.

say_en.note: Claude will present options like disable, reset password.
Claude will ask for closure options.
